ios.desc:
Remote Mouse™ turns your mobile device into a powerful remote control app for your PC or Mac. Use your phone or tablet as a wireless mouse, keyboard, and touchpad — complete with multi-touch gestures and media controls. Whether you're watching movies, controlling a presentation, or browsing the web from your couch, Remote Mouse™ offers an effortless way to control your computer remotely.

With over 20 million users and featured by CNET, Mashable, and Product Hunt, Remote Mouse™ offers one of the most elegant solutions to computer control from mobile.

What you can do:

Mouse  
• Control the cursor like a real PC mouse  
• Move using your phone’s gyroscope (Gyro Mouse)  
• Left-handed mode support

Keyboard  
• Type remotely in any language  
• Use voice input (if supported by your soft keyboard)
• Send system and app shortcuts
• Adaptive layouts for Mac or PC  
• Use your phone as a remote keyboard for your computer

Touchpad  
• Simulates Apple Magic Trackpad  
• Supports multi-touch gestures  
• Ideal wireless touchpad app for remote navigation

Specialty Panels  
• Media Remote: Control videos, music, and presentations across apps and sites like YouTube, Netflix, Disney+, Apple TV+, VLC, Spotify, and more.  
• Browser Remote: Navigate Chrome, Firefox, and Opera  
• App Switcher: Launch and switch between apps  
• Power Options: Shut down, sleep, or restart remotely  
• Clipboard Sync: Copy and paste text/images across devices

Other features  
• Control volume using physical phone buttons  
• Secure the connection with a password  
• Reorder specialty panels  
• Customize your remote with personal wallpapers

Connection & Compatibility
• Connect over Wi-Fi or Bluetooth
• Connect by IP address, QR code, or connection history
• Supports Windows, macOS, and Linux

Easy to set up:
1. Download and install Remote Mouse for desktop on your computer: [https://remotemouse.net](https://remotemouse.net)
2. Launch the desktop version (it runs in the background)
3. Connect your mobile device to your computer via Wi-Fi or Bluetooth
